scoring.modelReasoning: A form field's value is always a string. With subtotal a number, subtotal + shippingInput.value converts the number to a string and concatenates ('99.985.00'); parseFloat reads up to the second dot and returns 99.985, so shipping disappears, except when shipping is 0 ('99.980'). Convert the field with Number() where it enters and reject NaN. parseInt drops the cents, and unary plus applied after the concatenation gives NaN. Test 0, 5.00 and 5.99, and give finance the 318 short orders.
